text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Stand up straight and pull your chin in.<n>Good. I'll
measure your height now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to ask for a physical exam<n>so suddenly. I
just wanted to make<n>sure my application is filled
out<n>accurately.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. There,<n>all done.
You're 171 centimeters. Oh,<n>you've gotten taller.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I guess you must still be growing. I'll<n>forward the
information on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll take my leave no—

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... No, nothing's wrong. This<n>smell just brings
back some<n>memories.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I remember lying in a hospital bed<n>then, trying to
come up with a single<n>equation...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (A winning equation to beat her.)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Okay! I'm gonna pick upthe pace, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Wow, really?! Me too, me too! I'm not<n>gonna lose
to you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder, when was the last time I<n>was ahead of
her?)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Doctor? May I borrow Kinematics inSports next? I want to get faster.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Now's not the time to think about that.<n>You need to
rest. You do want to<n>recover quickly, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I think now's the best time to<n>do a lot of
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I panicked because I was<n>about to
lose... and that's how I got<n>injured.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to come up with a<n>winning
equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (So I don't lose again...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help. I should go<n>now.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! All of the staff at the<n>academy are
here to support you<n>students.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut. Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I will.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When I greet Biwa Hayahide after her<n>health exam,
I'm glad to see her<n>looking refreshed and free of
worries.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us are going to tackle the<n>Twinkle Series
starting today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Now that the date of my debut<n>race has
been decided, we know<n>what we need to do.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Train hard, formulate a path to victory,<n>and go into
the race with a solid<n>strategy. The results will
follow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
First, let's start by checking my times<n>to assess
where I currently am.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide is at the other end of<n>the track in a
flash.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We decide to measure her time after<n>each furlong,
or 200-meter interval. I<n>look at my stopwatch to
check.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That's a pretty fast lap. I wouldn't<n>expect any less
from Narita Brian's<n>big sister.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't look so surprised. We're<n>just here to
scope out the so-called<n>"number one contender"
around here.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
She didn't get that title for nothing.<n>Her run was a
sight to see in the<n>scrimmage I saw the other day!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, a group of other<n>trainers have
gathered around to<n>watch.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
We're all trainers here, right? We<n>need to see how
you carry out your<n>training sessions!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
I must say, I was surprised when I<n>heard Brian
was going to debut<n>before her older sister. But I
guess—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'm glad everyone's<n>having such a
good time, but I need to<n>have a word with my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'm glad everyone's<n>having such a
good time, but I need to<n>have a word with my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, well... Aren't you popular?
choice_data_list: I'm not the one who's popular. It's you!
I'm not the one who's popular. It's you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I tell Biwa Hayahide what the other<n>trainers were
saying about her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So I'm considered the number<n>one
contender, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's very flattering, but I can't<n>accept such
a mantle as things are at<n>the moment.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The reason they took an interest in<n>me to begin with
is because I'm<n>Narita Brian's sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm no more than above<n>average at the
moment, and I'm not<n>satisfied with that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't simply want to be above<n>average. I want to
become the<n>strongest racer here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her steely gaze seems fixed in her<n>mind's eye on
somewhere—or<n>someone—as she says this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... What result will the final<n>computation of
my equation bring? I<n>wonder if victory exists on the
list of<n>potential answers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... hahaha! I nearly forgot the type<n>of person you
are. Of course you'd<n>say that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll need all the help you can<n>give me. Let's
complete the winning<n>equation... together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And that's how my journey with<n>Biwa Hayahide
begins.
